public.fa_lens_score: Premium-priced quality compounder. Metrics (260630): PE ~36, ROE 17.7%, ROCE 11.1%, D/E 8.74 (normal — leverage IS the NBFC model), promoter 54.71%, sales 3y +25%, profit 3y +18%; market cap ₹6,10,393 Cr (mega-cap). Asset quality strong (GNPA 1.27% / NNPA 0.52%), AUM compounding +22% on a 119mn customer franchise = durable moat. Caveat: rich multiple vs moderate current ROE leaves little margin for a growth/credit-cost wobble — a hold-quality-at-a-price name, not deep value. Fundamental-8G 3/9 / Fundamental-10G 2/10 reflect the valuation/quality-gate friction, not franchise weakness. (seeded 2026-06-30)
public.journalist_brief: Q4 FY26 (ended Mar-2026, reported 29-Apr-2026): consolidated AUM crossed ₹5 trillion (₹5.09 lakh Cr, +22% YoY), standalone AUM ₹3.73 lakh Cr (+21%); consolidated PAT ₹5,553 Cr (+22%), standalone PAT ₹4,840 Cr (+23%); customer franchise 119.33 million (+17% YoY); GNPA 1.27% / NNPA 0.52%; ₹6/sh dividend. FY26 booked 51.95 million new loans (+21%). Long-run guidance AUM +25-27%, GNPA 1.2-1.4%. Largest retail/consumer-finance NBFC in India (Bajaj Finserv group), diversified across consumer-durable, personal, SME and mortgage loans plus a fast-scaling digital (Bajaj app) franchise. Web-verified 2026-06-30. (seeded 2026-06-30)
